mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, it is a comfortable 69 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, while the moon is currently in its first quarter phase.

The city is currently working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which is upgrading water, sewer, and stormwater infrastructure. Phase two is underway with tree removal and upcoming utility work, and the city is also continuing its long-term policy of installing sidewalks to improve neighborhood connectivity.

Today is packed with activities, including live music at Paddy Mac's, the Epic UGM event, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, tomorrow features Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and trivia at Hop Haus.
In a noteworthy call from August 15, Verona officers responded to a reckless driver report and arrested a 29-year-old local man for his second O W I offence, among other traffic charges.
Treat yourself to today's flavor of the day, which is Double Strawberry, at your local Culver's, which is open today until 10 PM.
